The '''RGC-18 landspeeder''' was a model of [[landspeeder]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation]]. It was based on the classic design of the<ref name="Head to Head" /> [[RGC-16 airspeeder]]<ref name="TVE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> on planets like [[Coruscant]], but was simplified as a landspeeder to be more affordable in the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Head to Head" />

Larger than typical landspeeder models, [[crime lord]] [[Cikatro Vizago]] and his [[IG-RM bodyguard and enforcer droid|thug droids]] made use of these, using their size and speed to make quick getaways and to transport heavy cargo.<ref name="DB">{{Databank|rgc-landspeeder|RGC Landspeeder}}</ref> [[Ryder Azadi]] flew a modified RGC-18 to escape from the [[Imperial Armory Complex]] on [[Lothal]] during attempts to infiltrate the factory.<ref name="AIM">{{Rebels|An Inside Man}}</ref>

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The RGC-18 landspeeder first appeared in the episode "[[Droids in Distress]]" of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'',<ref name="Droids">{{Rebels|Droids in Distress}}</ref> first released on [[October 3]], [[2014]].<ref name="Insider 156">{{InsiderCite|156|Star Wars Rebels Recounted|''Star Wars Rebels'' Recounted}}</ref> It was previously first featured in the book ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Head to Head]]''.<ref name="Head to Head" /> Concept art of Ryder Azadi's RGC-18 speeder for the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|season three]] episode "[[An Inside Man]]" was done by [[Luke Harrington]] and finished on [[November 5]], [[2015]]. The asset was sourced from the previous "Lothal Cruise Speeder AvB".<ref name="AIM BTS">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/an-inside-man-behind-the-scenes-gallery|text="An Inside Man" Behind-the-Scenes Gallery}} {{C|Slide 9}}</ref>
